messages:
Ravi: Uploaded a compact Terraform module set for the partner ref-arch (AWS/GCP). Focus: tiny sandbox, publishable artifacts, and a minimal CI smoke test.
Nora: nice. can you include a provider pin example and a quick note about region fallbacks? partners ask that a lot.
Ravi: added provider constraints in versions.tf and a region fallback map in variables with docs. Example uses `us-west1, us-west2` order.
Elena: for marketplace listing, we need a short install script that is idempotent and logs to stdout/stderr. Also add a dry-run flag.
Ravi: included install.sh with `--dry-run` and idempotent checks. Smoke test prints `OK` on success.
ci-bot: build #1021: terraform fmt/validate passed; smoke deploy queued on arm64 runner.
Nora: please add a PARTNER_CHECKLIST.md (legal, security review, support contact) before we hand off.
Ravi: added PARTNER_CHECKLIST.md and pinged the partner channel to schedule a 30m handoff next Thu 9am PT.
